dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, serrated light-gray perimeters enclosing darker centers, forming distinct 'O' and 'C' clusters across the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, isolated light-gray pixel clusters primarily located on the lower-lateral section near the base of the hind flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an irregular scalene triangle with the longest axis oriented longitudinally towards the posterior.
